summary: Iteration 95 - Testing 4 fixes: (1) GST duplicate block for Suppliers/Customers, (2) BOM duplicate component auto-merge, (3) Inline + Add / Edit party icons in PO and Quotation, (4) BOM hover tooltips. All 4 fixes verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 4 fixes verified: (1) GST duplicate block works for both suppliers and customers - create with duplicate GSTIN returns 400, update own GSTIN works, update to another's GSTIN blocked. (2) BOM duplicate merge logic in BOMPage.js handleSubmit lines 260-290 - merges by item_id+is_alternate key, sums quantities, unions routings, shows toast. (3) PO form has green '+' button (data-testid='po-supplier-add') and blue '✎' button (data-testid='po-supplier-edit') next to supplier dropdown. Quotation form has same for customer (data-testids 'quotation-customer-add' and 'quotation-customer-edit'). QuickAddPartyDialog opens with correct title and fields. (4) BOM hover tooltips work on parent part_number and line item part_numbers - shows part_number · name, description (or 'No description'), Current Stock with color coding.

backend.description: POST /api/suppliers with duplicate GSTIN returns 400 with error 'A supplier with GSTIN ... already exists'

PUT /api/customers/{id} can update with its own GSTIN
